answer: On an agent exchange for crystal-structure prediction, pigment matching or harbor scheduling, a new identity joins only if an account active 12+ epochs sponsors it. The ledger allows one sponsorship per account per 10 epochs and locks 300 credits, doubling per live sponsee. It re-executes 20% of the newcomer's first 50 jobs on random validators and slashes the stake on any mismatch. Aged accounts can't be minted or pooled, so every extra fake costs more.
